# GrepSignal

> Evidence-backed intelligence on material shifts across AI models, agents, tooling, and infrastructure, with a technical-builder bias.

GrepSignal is not a comprehensive news feed. JSON is the canonical machine-readable interface; HTML is the human presentation layer.

## Start here

- [Canonical intelligence](https://cinic0101.github.io/grepsignal/data/intelligence.json): Full current snapshot of Signals, Threads, Predictions, evidence, falsifiers, limitations, lifecycle, and derived relationships.
- [Changes](https://cinic0101.github.io/grepsignal/data/changes.json): Sequence-cursor change feed with proposal provenance, deterministic revision diffs, and hashed public acceptance receipts.
- [Coverage](https://cinic0101.github.io/grepsignal/data/coverage.json): What the current review cycle examined, including no-publish outcomes.
- [For agents](https://cinic0101.github.io/grepsignal/agents/): Consumption guidance and interpretation rules.
- [Intelligence schema](https://cinic0101.github.io/grepsignal/schema/intelligence.schema.json): Field semantics and machine-readable contract.
- [Record-version schema](https://cinic0101.github.io/grepsignal/schema/record-version.schema.json): Immutable citation snapshot envelope.

## Record resources

- Signal JSON: `/grepsignal/data/signals/{signal_id}.json`
- Thread JSON: `/grepsignal/data/threads/{thread_id}.json`
- Prediction JSON: `/grepsignal/data/predictions/{prediction_id}.json`
- Immutable Signal version: `/grepsignal/data/signals/{signal_id}/versions/{version}.json`
- Immutable Thread version: `/grepsignal/data/threads/{thread_id}/versions/{version}.json`
- Immutable Prediction version: `/grepsignal/data/predictions/{prediction_id}/versions/{version}.json`

Current record JSON includes `cite_as`, `record_version_permalink`, and the latest public `projection_sequence`. Version resources are immutable snapshots captured when that record reached the requested version. Derived cross-record context is frozen at the snapshot sequence and may later differ from the mutable current projection. Version resources are served with long-lived immutable cache headers; use the current record URL when you need the latest projection.

Current record JSON also includes `retrieval_identity`: actor/entity names deterministically derived from accepted evidence publisher metadata and explicit Thread relations. This field exists to improve entity-plus-event discovery and agent lookup. It is non-canonical discovery metadata; do not treat it as an additional factual claim, and do not expect it on immutable version snapshots.

Signal records expose derived `thread_ids` and typed `thread_relations`. Thread records expose derived `signal_ids` and `signal_relations`. These are projections of the canonical Thread-link history, not separately curated facts.

## Interpretation

- `registered_at` is when GrepSignal registered a record; it is not automatically the event date or publication date.
- `first_observed_at`, `first_public_at`, `published_at`, `retrieved_at`, and journal `recorded_at` have distinct meanings. Null means unknown, not absent.
- Version 0 denotes an imported legacy snapshot. It does not imply complete pre-migration event history.
- Carry falsifiers, limitations, lifecycle, review requirements, and prediction resolution state forward when reusing a judgment.
- Follow original evidence URLs when source detail matters. GrepSignal publishes synthesis and metadata, not mirrored third-party article bodies.

## Human-readable

- [Signals](https://cinic0101.github.io/grepsignal/signals/)
- [Threads](https://cinic0101.github.io/grepsignal/threads/)
- [Changes](https://cinic0101.github.io/grepsignal/changes/)
- [Editorial policy](https://cinic0101.github.io/grepsignal/editorial/)

- In source metadata, `lineage_id` groups URLs derived from the same underlying evidence event when known. Null means lineage was not established, not that the source is independent.
- For `revise` events, prefer `changed_fields` over reconstructing differences from prose notes.
